ITEM 1. BUSINESS

Globex Freight Corporation ("Globex") is a less-than-truckload and intermodal freight carrier serving shippers across North America. We operate 312 service centers and a fleet of approximately 9,800 tractors and 31,000 trailers. Globex was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Memphis, Tennessee.

We report two segments: LTL Freight and Intermodal. In fiscal 2024, LTL Freight generated 81% of our revenue. We employ approximately 21,400 people, of whom approximately 12,900 are drivers and dock workers.

ITEM 1A. RISK FACTORS

Fuel prices are volatile. Diesel fuel is one of our largest operating costs. Although our fuel surcharge programs recover much of the increase in fuel prices, there is a lag between changes in fuel prices and changes in our surcharges, which can reduce our operating income in periods of rising prices.

We may not be able to hire and keep enough qualified drivers. The trucking industry faces a long-term shortage of qualified drivers. Higher driver wages and recruiting costs could reduce our margins.

A cyberattack could disrupt our operations. Our dispatch, billing and shipment tracking systems are critical to our business. A ransomware attack or other security breach could stop our ability to pick up and deliver freight.

ITEM 7. MANAGEMENT'S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS OF FINANCIAL CONDITION AND RESULTS OF OPERATIONS

Freight demand was soft in the first half of fiscal 2024 because of weak industrial production, and improved in the second half. Tonnage per day decreased 3.1% for the full year, while revenue per hundredweight, excluding fuel surcharges, increased 6.4% as we continued to price for the value of our service.
